name: Test Release Trigger

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry-run:
        description: 'Run release workflow in dry‑run mode'
        required: true
        default: 'true'
        type: boolean

jobs:
  trigger-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Trigger release workflow in integrations-core
        uses: benc-uk/workflow-dispatch@v1

          workflow: release.yml

          inputs: |
            dry-run: ${{ github.event.inputs.dry-run }}
          ref: ${{ github.ref }}
          repo: DataDog/integrations-core
          wait-for-completion: true
          wait-timeout-seconds: 3600
          wait-interval-seconds: 30
          sync-status: true
